query_text: Vehicle not getting in to ready mode and vehicle control system warning showing in cluster
expected_cause:

*Checked and confirmed the customer concern  vehicle not starting and vehicle control system warning showing in cluster
*While driving, the vehicle gets a control fault and shuts off. After keeping it stopped for some time, the complaint gets resolved temporarily, but later it replicates again.
*When the 12V battery was checked, the voltage was low. So, the battery was replaced and checked again, at that time also, the control fault system warning complaint was replicated.
*Later, when the vehicle was scanned, the below-mentioned DTC were found.
              BMS P187873 Main switch: main positive switch stick -Current
              BMS P186573 ALM_RELAY_FAIL    - History
             VCU B108600 Battery Main Positive Relay Status (Bat Ma Pos Rly Sts)Adhesion -Current
             VCU B104A00 Battery Fault Level (BatF ltLvl) Battary DisCharge Open Request- Current
* Based on the   DTC we suspect the issue in HVB and informed TACO team to conduct the HVB inspection.
* Also conducted the MCU diode test Drive motor inspection and found values are in limit as per check list . Attached the inspection check list for 
  the references.
*A Taco service engineer inspected the HVB and observed an issue with the BDU inside the HVB.
* Based on the inspection, Taco shared the repair quotation, and the dealer approved and paid for the HVB repair.
*Attached the Taco service report (FSR). Also attached are the before-and-after logs and live data of the HVB repair for reference.
Action Taken
 * HVB repaired by Taco SE and replaced BDU inside the HVB. 
Conclusion
*After repairing the HVB, the vehicle was turned to Ready mode. We conducted a test drive of more than 30 km, and the vehicle was delivered to the customer.

query_text: concern that it was not entering Ready Mode.
expected_cause:
Dear Sir,
We recently received the following vehicle with the customer concern that it was not entering Ready Mode.
The vehicle was received with the customer's complaint that it intermittently failed to start and did not enter Ready Mode.
During inspection, the concern was verified, and the vehicle failed to enter Ready Mode during diagnosis.
Observations:
•	The Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL) was illuminated in the instrument cluster.
•	VDS diagnostics were performed, and the following DTCs were recorded
•	o    P187973 – Main Switch: Main Negative Switch Stuck Current
•	o    VCU B104A00 – Battery Fault Level (Bat Flt Lvl): Battery Discharge Open Request Current
•	                        B108700 Battery Main Negative Relay Status (Bat Ma Neg Rly Sts Adhesion Current

Diagnostic Checks Performed:
•	Inspected all high-voltage (HV) connectors – No abnormalities found.
•	Checked the insulation resistance (IR) value – Within specification.
As per the Service E-Manual diagnostic procedure for the above DTCs, the recommended corrective action was replacement of the Hybrid/EV Battery Pack.
However, as per the Tata company plant report, the required parts were initially not covered under warranty. After discussion with the MGI Technical Team, it was advised to replace the required parts under MGI warranty instead of replacing the complete battery pack.
Accordingly, the following parts were replaced under MGI warranty:
•	BDU (Battery Disconnect Unit)
•	Main Negative Connector
Tata company replaced the failure parts.
After replacement of the above components, the vehicle was tested, and the concern was completely resolved. The vehicle is now entering Ready Mode normally, and no further issues were observed.
Regards,
Prabhat Kumar

VOC:  Vehicle stopped while running.
WD: When reception time 12V battery was fully drained we fixed a good battery and diagnosed the vehicle, and found the DTCs B100016, P1A2212, and C100016. We cleared the DTCs and confirmed the vehicle entered ready mode. We diagnosed the vehicle and found the DTC P1A2212: DCDC Self-Test failure (current). 
Root cause: As per the DTC reference, we checked and confirmed that the 12V battery is not charging when the vehicle is in ready mode. We removed the CDU, inspected then confirmed the CDU fuse was blown. Suspected CDU fault.
Conclusion: Replaced the CDU, then cleared DTCS and confirmed the 12V battery is charging when the vehicle is in idle

query_text: *Air bag warning lamp displayed in instrument cluster while the vehicle get in ready mode condition
expected_cause:
Observation
*Confirmed the customer concern air bag warning lamp displayed in instrument cluster while the vehicle get in ready mode condition
*VDS connected and scan the vehicle ,observed history DTC SDM module (DTC B108800：ECU Internal Error,B104600：Frontal Airbag Driver High Resistance)
*After try to clear the DTC ,but the DTC are not cleared and still it showing SDM module 
*Check the frontal air bag connector for any  loose connection or corrosion, but no more abnormalities were observed
*After removing frontal air bag connector, added Foam tap Coil to  airbag connectors and re fix the connector
*After attempting to clear the DTC, the DTC remained showing and could not be cleared.
*As per the DTC B108800 checked the SDM module and also checked its connector , no abnormalities were observed
*After check the F35D 10 A fuse in instrument panel and found its okay
*Then check the SDM module Connector pins voltage and grounds resistance , get the values are okay
         Pin no.5   getting 12.2 V(IGN)
         pin no.34  getting 2.6 V (CAN H
        pin no.33   getting 2.3 V
        pin no.6  and G102 is getting 0.0 ohms
*Based in our inspection we suspect the issues in SDM module
*DTC log ,live data ,check sheet ,photos and videos are attached
Action Taken
*Replaced SDM module under warranty
Conclusion
*After replacing SDM module the concern was resolved
